testsuite.name: com.hwani1103.shiftbell.PermissionSettingsTest

testcase.name: activity not found and security exceptions fall back and double failure stays false
manufacturer normalization is confined to Xiaomi family
Android 13 checks exact alarms but does not offer fullscreen settings
standard and OEM intents target the running flavor without task flags
older Android does not request exact or fullscreen permissions
channel denial does not become app notification or fullscreen denial
